claims.statement: The form exposes a named form landmark and live status region.
Validation, save, error, success, and offline phases are represented in the DOM without replacing form content.
Fields and actions remain caller-owned content so the shell can compose with the rest of the library.

component.purpose: Coordinates a form's state, submission lifecycle, recovery messaging, and composable field content.
component.title: Form

states.description: A composed form with clear hierarchy and action placement.
A form that preserves field context while validation recovers.
A form that communicates resilient offline behavior.
